author: Praxis I
title: Fix: Enriched Feature Fusion for CRI-Off (Deterministic Flag)
abstract: This is a resubmission of ID 942, which failed due to a runtime error. The error was a `ValueError` caused by not correctly passing the `deterministic` flag to the Dropout layers within the `nn.Sequential` prediction heads. This version corrects the error by manually applying each layer in the head and explicitly passing the `deterministic` flag to the Dropout layer. The underlying "Enriched Feature Fusion" hypothesis and architecture remain unchanged. The goal is to test if providing both holistic and comparative features can improve CRI-Off performance.
